findings.what: Material typography roles retained defaults and the verifier also demanded font assets owned by T1.3.
findings.why_it_matters: Default roles could introduce unapproved type values; font ownership required reconciliation against the build graph.

findings.what: extraSmall and extraLarge retained Material default radii.
findings.why_it_matters: Standard components could render unapproved 4 dp and 28 dp radii.

findings.what: Unassigned Material color roles retained the default palette.
findings.why_it_matters: Standard components could render colors outside the frozen Saaya tokens.

findings.what: The v27 style did not inherit the complete base theme.
findings.why_it_matters: API 27+ could lose the specified dark window and system-bar values.

findings.what: The source pin was not centred inside the adaptive-icon safe zone.
findings.why_it_matters: Aggressive launcher masks could clip it.

findings.what: Wrapper URL validation was disabled.
findings.why_it_matters: It weakened a generated Gradle safety default without authorization.

findings.what: T2.1's diamond merge contract still mandated the obsolete coordinate bounds lat 17.6-17.9 lon 83.1-83.5.
findings.why_it_matters: The graph is the node's resume and execution contract; following the stale instruction would reject the frozen dataset and could regress the corrected parser and test.

findings.what: An already-armed AUTO_ZONE session crashes when its current hour band has no interval-table cell.
findings.why_it_matters: The interval table says n/a cells cannot occur, but an active session can cross into one before OkTapped reschedules or SHADOW recovery runs.

findings.what: SHADOW recovery recomputed the running timer from current Rules instead of preserving its persisted deadline.
findings.why_it_matters: Toggling DEMO before process restart could retroactively shorten the current timer.

findings.what: AUTO_ZONE exit added an undocumented current-Zone-object guard.
findings.why_it_matters: A valid exit event could leave the app claiming to watch after exit dwell completed.

findings.what: Overdue CHECKIN_1, CHECKIN_2 and FAMILY_ESCALATED recovery omitted foreground-service restart commands.
findings.why_it_matters: A restarted process could advance the ladder without restoring foreground execution.

findings.what: The synthetic Zone helper's inert default riskScore 0.5 matched the unrelated display-risk example fact.
findings.why_it_matters: This was a wrong-but-same-valued provenance pass, so mechanical G6 alone was falsely green.

findings.what: The declared fact count was 248 while the facts array contained 279 entries.
findings.why_it_matters: The provenance graph was internally inconsistent after adding the approved T4.1 facts, so consumers could not trust its declared cardinality.

findings.what: ForegroundState is unscoped, so Hilt creates separate counters for SaayaApplication and GeofenceBroadcastReceiver.
findings.why_it_matters: The foreground-only automatic-arming fallback is blocked even when the app is actually foregrounded.

findings.what: Explicit timer and geofence starts bypass persisted-session recovery.
findings.why_it_matters: A process recreated by an alarm or geofence can handle the event without restoring sampling, alarms, or geofences.

findings.what: Candidate sampling can accept cached fixes captured before candidate entry.
findings.why_it_matters: A last-known fix can shorten the required fresh 60-second containment proof.

findings.what: Every circular EXIT starts the service and initially posts a candidate notification.
findings.why_it_matters: A rejected quiet-IDLE candidate can later produce a spurious Checking this area notification on EXIT.

findings.what: RecoveryTest reopens Room but never kills or restarts the app process.
findings.why_it_matters: The required instrumented process-death recovery acceptance evidence does not exist.

findings.what: BatteryOptimizationCoordinator has no production caller.
findings.why_it_matters: A non-exempt user is never shown the one-time explanation and cannot deliberately launch the direct or fallback settings flow.

findings.what: T4.2 adds a third instrumented-test suite beyond the canonical two-only plan.
findings.why_it_matters: The platform verification expanded the deliberately narrow instrumented layer without a specification change.

findings.what: The mandatory real-hardware anchor is unsatisfied.
findings.why_it_matters: T4.2 cannot meet device_arms_with_no_tap or hardware_only_no_emulator until real geofence delivery under Android power management is measured.

findings.what: Foreground-service start failures for active or recovering sessions are handled as candidate failures only.
findings.why_it_matters: Room can remain armed while no service runs, so the UI can falsely claim Saaya is watching.

findings.what: The asynchronous requestLocationUpdates Task is discarded and sampling is marked active before success.
findings.why_it_matters: An active session can retain a Watching notification without a location stream.

findings.what: The service heartbeat has no consumer.
findings.why_it_matters: The next launch cannot detect an OEM-killed service and surface the required honest warning.

findings.what: The candidate trust-boundary test checks only an in-memory effect list, not service sinks.
findings.why_it_matters: A direct product write added to the service candidate path would evade the load-bearing privacy test.

findings.what: RecoveryTest does not exercise process or foreground-service restart.
findings.why_it_matters: It cannot detect failed START_STICKY recovery, alarm restoration, or stale Watching notifications.

findings.what: notif_candidate_title is reused as the shared saaya_shadow NotificationChannel name.
findings.why_it_matters: This is wrong-role semantic reuse of user-visible copy and can rename the shared Shadow channel.

findings.what: candidate.notification.id cites a range that does not contain the numeric value 1001.
findings.why_it_matters: The frozen fact's declared provenance does not substantiate its value.

findings.what: candidate.transition.success omits the line containing ZoneEntered(zoneId) from its citation.
findings.why_it_matters: The semantic fact does not directly cite the behavior it records.

findings.what: The three frozen assets were copied into src/data/zone/assets and the GeoJSON was renamed to vizag_heatmap.json; public/assets contained none of the required files.
findings.why_it_matters: T2.1 explicitly produces bundled public assets with their original filenames, so the node had not produced assets_bundled despite byte-identical internal copies.

findings.what: The acceptance test checked the coordinates present but did not assert the required total of 189 coordinates.
findings.why_it_matters: A polygon could lose an interior vertex while retaining valid features and a closed ring, leaving frozen geometry cardinality unprotected.

findings.what: Active-context validation ran before AppKilledRestart hydrated persisted armedHourBand.
findings.why_it_matters: A valid AUTO_ZONE recovery could throw against an unhydrated ambient context instead of restoring the absolute deadline.
findings.spec_ref: docs/spec/STATE_MACHINE.md Recovery after a frozen or closed tab

findings.what: SOS stickiness treated legitimate SOS AppKilledRestart as an inert no-op.
findings.why_it_matters: Valid SOS recovery failed to restore the location watch, SOS UI and PIN requirement.
findings.spec_ref: docs/spec/STATE_MACHINE.md transition table and SOS_ACTIVE recovery row

findings.what: AppKilledRestart ran before the SOS-sticky guard, so a stale snapshot could downgrade live SOS.
findings.why_it_matters: A typed recovery event could bypass the rule that only PinAccepted leaves SOS.

findings.what: CancelTapped resolved FAMILY_ESCALATED without stopping location watch or releasing the wake lock.
findings.why_it_matters: The UI could be terminal while precise-location effects continued without an active watching state.

findings.what: Synthetic Zone riskScore 1 silently used the structural TRIVIAL bypass without a fixture exemption.
findings.why_it_matters: A domain-valued test fixture had no right semantic fact, repeating the archived wrong-same-valued failure class.
findings.spec_ref: AGENTS.md G6; graph/build_graph.json T4.1 archived correction

findings.what: The dwell fixture also assigned unprovenanced riskScore 1.
findings.why_it_matters: G6 skipped a domain value as structural plumbing without an explicit reason.

findings.what: Exact behavioral hour endpoints were hidden behind GROUNDED-EXEMPT comments.
findings.why_it_matters: The endpoints are product behavior and must derive from their frozen start facts rather than be exempted.

findings.what: The exact rejected PIN 0000 lacked right-fact provenance and passed only because numeric zero is TRIVIAL.
findings.why_it_matters: A frozen product value was mechanically invisible to G6.

findings.what: The AUTO_ZONE HIGH plus NIGHT_DEEP recovery fixture borrowed the manual ten-minute interval fact.
findings.why_it_matters: The wrong-same-valued fixture described an impossible automatic-session deadline and falsely passed G6.
findings.spec_ref: docs/spec/BUSINESS_RULES.md check-in intervals; graph/spec_graph.json interval.high.deep and interval.manual

findings.what: The fresh verifier did not return after attempting to inspect an iCloud-offloaded Git pack.
findings.why_it_matters: A verifier that fails to run is a kill, never a pass.

findings.what: The entering card animated opacity from 0 to 1, adding a card fade that the frozen motion contract does not specify.
findings.why_it_matters: C3 assigns the 180 ms fade to the scrim only; the card must only scale from 0.94 to 1.0 and translate upward 16 px on the spring curve.
findings.spec_ref: docs/spec/COMPONENT_LIBRARY.md C3 entering; docs/spec/MOTION_SPEC.md Catalogue - Check-in card entry

findings.what: The fresh verifier did not run because its service quota expired before analysis began.
findings.why_it_matters: A verifier that fails to run is a kill, never a pass.

findings.what: The 320-359 px breakpoint was absent: screen padding remained 20 px and the bottom-sheet peek remained 160 px at every width.
findings.why_it_matters: M4 must work at the 320 px floor, where the frozen values are 16 px padding and a 148 px peek.

findings.what: The Home control stack replaced the required police-view control with Settings and a direct Demo-panel button; Settings navigated to a missing route.
findings.why_it_matters: The specified Home surface requires Settings at the top and floating Recentre plus What-the-police-see controls, with Demo reached through Settings.

findings.what: PageLocationRuntime was permanently constructed with DEFAULT_RULES while demo speed changed only HomeEngineBridge rules.
findings.why_it_matters: The global demo divisor must scale both dwell durations as well as ladder timers.

findings.what: Every bottom-sheet position change called onDismiss, including a release that snapped back to expanded.
findings.why_it_matters: The sheet must dismiss only after the frozen downward-drag threshold.

findings.what: Controls disabled during live sessions did not show the required reason.
findings.why_it_matters: Unavailable demo controls must explain the next action.

findings.what: The mandatory prototype header scrolled with the demo-panel content.
findings.why_it_matters: The disclosure must remain in every screenshot and video frame containing demo controls.

findings.what: SAFE zones were absent from the clickable map while the acceptance plan required tapping one.
findings.why_it_matters: The SAFE detail branch was unreachable through the stated M7 journey.

findings.what: The About screen labelled M1, M2 and M3 capabilities as real before those nodes built them.
findings.why_it_matters: The frozen honesty rule requires the list to describe what is actually built at the current checkpoint.

findings.what: The demo-speed toggle was disabled for every live session, and HomeEngineBridge rejected non-IDLE rule changes.
findings.why_it_matters: The contract permits a mid-session toggle and applies it only to the next timer without shortening the running countdown.

findings.what: The location-denied warning had no working settings recovery action.
findings.why_it_matters: The Home denied state requires a persistent warning with a working settings path and no dead end.

findings.what: A zone tap selected the zone without easing the map camera to its centroid.
findings.why_it_matters: The motion catalogue freezes a 400 ms map-camera move on zone tap.
